definitions.explanation: A suffix indicating an academic field or branch of study.

examples.japanese: {海洋|かいよう}{学|がく}を{専攻|せんこう}している。
{心理|しんり}{学|がく}に{興味|きょうみ}がある。
{大学|だいがく}で{経済|けいざい}{学|がく}を{学|まな}んだ。

notes:
〜{学|がく} is a productive suffix meaning "-ology" or "study of," attached to a topic to form the name of an academic discipline.

COMMON FIELDS:
- {科学|かがく}: science
- {数学|すうがく}: mathematics
- {物理学|ぶつりがく}: physics
- {化学|かがく}: chemistry
- {生物学|せいぶつがく}: biology
- {心理学|しんりがく}: psychology
- {経済学|けいざいがく}: economics
- {言語学|げんごがく}: linguistics
- {医学|いがく}: medicine
- {法学|ほうがく}: law

USAGE:
Highly productive — you can form new academic fields by attaching {学|がく} to a subject: {環境|かんきょう}{学|がく} (environmental studies), {情報|じょうほう}{学|がく} (information science). Words like {科学|かがく} and {数学|すうがく} are so common that the {学|がく} feels like part of the word rather than a suffix.

RELATED SUFFIXES:
- 〜{者|しゃ}: person (adding to field: {科学者|かがくしゃ} scientist)
- 〜{部|ぶ}: department ({文学部|ぶんがくぶ} literature department)
